citations.claim: body still inside right boundary at step 190
body approaching right edge, overshoot rising
first violating step, centre+radius exceeds arena limit by 0.178

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.016455 to 0.005, keeping same steps, which increases temporal resolution and prevents overshoot beyond right wall.

explanation: Body gains rightward velocity after interacting with wall/floor and with dt=0.0164 moves ~0.044 per step at ~2.7 m/s. At x~19.04 near step 190 it is within arena, but in next ~4 steps it crosses the right boundary. Position correction / substepping insufficient at this dt allows centre+radius to exceed 20+0.15 tolerance, violating in_arena at step 194. Reducing dt to 0.005 provides sufficient resolution to keep body inside arena.
vision_note: The red circle sits in the bottom-right corner and progressively protrudes through the right boundary wall from step 191 to 194. By step 194 a significant portion of the body is visibly outside the black arena border, showing a slow lateral escape rather than a sudden jump.
